input.description: Input CSS path, relative to projectBase.

output.description: Generated CSS path, relative to projectBase.

projectBase.description: Project base path. Relative paths are resolved from Heft's buildFolderPath; the default is buildFolderPath itself.

prefix.description: Optional lowercase Tailwind class prefix without punctuation.

optimize.description: Optimize and minify CSS. Defaults to Heft's --production parameter.

sourceGlobs.description: Source globs watched during incremental builds, relative to projectBase.
